name: Tottenham Hotspur
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Spurs fans decide the ranking.

cards.name: Jimmy Greaves
cards.tagline: 220 league goals, and he still says you should have shot.

cards.name: Glenn Hoddle
cards.tagline: Sees the pass nobody else can, then explains it twice.

cards.name: Ledley King
cards.tagline: Quiet, calm, and the only one who never lunges.

cards.name: Dave Mackay
cards.tagline: Sits with his arms folded and nobody dares move his chair.

cards.name: Danny Blanchflower
cards.tagline: Wants the game played with style, and will say so loudly.

cards.name: Harry Kane
cards.tagline: Keeps count of every goal, his own included.

cards.name: Son Heung-min
cards.tagline: Smiles through a 0-0 and hugs the whole row after a goal.

cards.name: David Ginola
cards.tagline: Treats a dull first half as a personal insult.

cards.name: Mousa Dembele
cards.tagline: Never rushes, never panics, and never gives you the ball back.

cards.name: Rafael van der Vaart
cards.tagline: Gets louder every time Arsenal lose.

cards.name: Bill Nicholson
cards.tagline: Wants it done properly and will tell you when it is not.

cards.name: Keith Burkinshaw
cards.tagline: Straight talker with a dry line for every occasion.

cards.name: Arthur Rowe
cards.tagline: Wants it quick: push it, run into space, repeat.

cards.name: Mauricio Pochettino
cards.tagline: Has you pressing from the stands by the second half.

cards.name: Harry Redknapp
cards.tagline: Always has a bargain signing and a story to go with it.

cards.name: Martin Jol
cards.tagline: Warm, funny, and never tells you to calm down.

cards.name: Ange Postecoglou
cards.tagline: Says we attack until the end, so the whole pub attacks too.

cards.name: Terry Venables
cards.tagline: Always has a plan on a napkin and a story to go with it.

cards.name: Juande Ramos
cards.tagline: Few words, lots of focus, no small talk.

cards.name: John Cameron
cards.tagline: Won the 1901 FA Cup, so he asks what you have won.

cards.name: Adele
cards.tagline: Sings along to everything and swears at the referee in the same breath.

cards.name: Tom Holland
cards.tagline: Loses his voice by half-time and does not care.

cards.name: Jude Law
cards.tagline: Has been going for decades and tells it calmly.

cards.name: Kenneth Branagh
cards.tagline: Narrates the match like a Shakespeare play.

cards.name: Steve Nash
cards.tagline: Plays every pass in his head before the player does.

cards.name: Michael McIntyre
cards.tagline: Turns every near miss into a five-minute routine.

cards.name: Paul Whitehouse
cards.tagline: Has an impression for every player and every ref.

cards.name: J.K. Rowling
cards.tagline: Knows the lore of the club better than anyone in the pub.

cards.name: Bob Marley
cards.tagline: Keeps it calm, keeps it positive, and plays after the final whistle.

cards.name: Zac Efron
cards.tagline: Shirt on, scarf on, first to the pub.
